|-- [M] Modular structure - boundaries, visibility and component dependencies
|   |-- Analysis contract: StaticAnalyzer.analyze(request) -> Promise<StaticAnalysisResult>
|   |   |-- Request: repository + tsconfig + selected paths + views + frameworks + metrics
|   |   |-- Selection limits fact emission; imports may still support symbol resolution
|   |   `-- Result: artifact + measurements + compiler resolution mode
|   |-- Extraction subsystem: staticAnalyzer implements the contract
|   |   |-- AnalysisContext: compiler access, entity/relation registry, evidence and snapshot
|   |   |   `-- Private machinery: active program, checker, compiler configuration and input pinning
|   |   |-- Declarations: index declarations, resolve names, imports and JSX composition
|   |   |   |-- Local names resolve through enclosing scopes before TypeChecker lookup
|   |   |   `-- External declarations become summaries associated with the referencing module
|   |   `-- Collaborators: lexical, calls, resources, frameworks, dataflow and callbacks
|   |-- Domain subsystem: extraction depends on its artifact contract and derivation functions
|   |   |-- Schema: entities + typed relations + provenance + uncertainties + derived results
|   |   |-- deriveAnalysis -> partition evaluation + graph condensation + findings
|   |   `-- joinSourceRange / partitionFromSourceJoins -> diagram-to-source correspondence
|   |-- Optional reuse boundary: IncrementalAnalyzer wraps an injected StaticAnalyzer
|   |   |-- Public: analyze, exportCheckpoint, restoreCheckpoint
|   |   `-- Private: checkpoint, busy guard and update assembly
|   `-- Structural evidence combines containment and lexical information conceptually
|       |-- Component links: imports, reexports and JSX composition
|       |-- Name boundaries: declarations, scope parents, references and captures
|       |-- Schema retains separate containment/lexical views and exported metadata
|       `-- Logical grouping: layer/feature metadata and concept partitions from diagram leaves
|           `-- Source paths remain evidence anchors; they need not define conceptual groups
|-- [C] Invocation structure - CLI entry and analysis orchestration
|   |-- CLI -> staticAnalyzer.analyze directly; no interactive backend in this path
|   |   |-- Select TS/TSX inputs from tsconfig, optionally filtered by path prefixes
|   |   `-- Request all views and React/Zustand/tldraw/controller framework analysis
|   |-- staticAnalyzer.analyze
|   |   |-- Construct AnalysisContext + Declarations
|   |   |-- declarations.index -> imports -> composition
|   |   |-- Any view beyond containment requested? -> extractLexical
|   |   |-- Calls, ownership or dependencies requested?
|   |   |   |-- Resources.initialize -> extractCalls -> extractFrameworks
|   |   |   `-- Ownership or dependencies requested?
|   |   |       `-- prepareDataflow -> releaseCompiler -> extractDataflow
|   |   |           `-- connectCallbackCandidates
|   |   `-- context.finish -> release extraction state -> deriveAnalysis -> return result
|   |-- IncrementalAnalyzer.analyze -> guarded update
|   |   |-- Inventory current inputs and module resolution, including newly resolved imports
|   |   |-- Combine current import edges with cached analysis dependency edges
|   |   |-- Form dependency components; uncertain global effects broaden to one component
|   |   |-- For each component containing selected paths
|   |   |   |-- Matching fragment key -> reuse cached facts
|   |   |   `-- Cache miss -> extractor.analyze for that component's selected paths
|   |   `-- Merge facts -> fresh snapshot -> recompute derived results -> publish checkpoint
|   `-- Analyzed call relations are static evidence, not recorded runtime activations
|       |-- Schema distinguishes direct, virtual, union, callback and unknown dispatch
|       `-- Runtime identities are reserved; this pipeline does not establish an observed call tree
|-- [O] Responsibility for compiler state, cached facts and output resources
|   |-- One AnalysisContext owns mutable extraction registries and compiler references
|   |   |-- Start with a syntax program; first checker access builds semantic resolution
|   |   |-- prepareDataflow resolves needed inputs while compiler access is available
|   |   |-- releaseCompiler pins compiler inputs, then drops active program/checker references
|   |   `-- finish copies facts into artifact arrays; release clears working maps and AST lists
|   |-- Module-level previousProgram retains compiler state for reuse across small analyses
|   |   `-- Selections over 100 files clear prior reuse and release their retained program
|   |-- IncrementalAnalyzer owns its session checkpoint
|   |   |-- Export and restore use structured clones; restore validates fragment artifacts
|   |   |-- Busy guard rejects concurrent updates and restore during a run
|   |   |-- try/finally clears busy even when analysis fails
|   |   `-- Replace checkpoint only after complete assembly succeeds
|   |-- CLI owns persisted output publication
|   |   |-- Canonical chunks -> gzip stream -> temporary artifact -> rename
|   |   |   `-- finally removes the temporary artifact path
|   |   `-- Report and run manifest are each written to temporary paths, then renamed
|   `-- Ownership vocabulary in the analyzed artifact
|       |-- creates, retains, aliases, can-mutate and exposes-read-api
|       `-- subscribes, unsubscribes, disposes and escapes
|           `-- Relations carry provenance and optional capability/depth; vocabulary alone proves no lifetime
`-- [D] Computational dependencies - graph facts underneath the organizational views
    |-- Pinned analysis artifact needs source/configuration inputs + extracted facts
    |   |-- Snapshot: file hashes, analyzed/resolution-only/configuration roles, compiler settings
    |   |   `-- Git commit and dirty inputs when available; content hashes also support non-Git inputs
    |   |-- Evidence: snapshot + file hash + UTF-16 range + method + status + supporting relations
    |   |   `-- Unresolved sites produce uncertainty records and partial view coverage
    |   `-- Measurements remain separate from deterministic persisted facts
    |-- Reusable fragment needs an unchanged component key
    |   |-- Analyzer/compiler/environment identity + selected component paths
    |   `-- Component member content hashes + current resolution observations
    |       `-- Reuse still requires a fresh snapshot header and recomputed derived results
    |-- Dependency facts are edges, independent of any chosen partition
    |   |-- Schema supports value-flow, arguments, returns, reads/writes and control
    |   `-- Also reactive/select/prop/context/effect dependencies and awaits
    |-- Derived comparisons need the same source-entity universe + graph layers + partitions
    |   |-- Universe: analyzed source entities, excluding structural/type/external scaffolding
    |   |-- Layers select resolved/inferred relations with unit-per-relation weighting
    |   |   |-- Calls: calls + constructs
    |   |   |-- Data: value-flow + argument + return + reads + writes
    |   |   |-- State: reads + writes
    |   |   `-- Reactive: reactive + selects + prop-flow + context-read + effect-dependency
    |   |-- Built-in partitions: directory, layer and all-source single group
    |   |-- Metrics: coverage, edge mass, cohesion, partition difference and seeded shuffle baseline
    |   |-- Per-layer strongly connected components condense cycles and retain relation IDs
    |   `-- Also derive findings and a containment tree projection
    |-- Concept partition needs diagram leaf groups + matched joins to source entities
    |   |-- joinSourceRange checks snapshot ID, path and file hash
    |   |   |-- Mismatch -> stale, with no matched entities; never silently rebase
    |   |   `-- Valid pin -> validate offsets -> fully-contained or intersects matching
    |   |       |-- Eligible source entities found -> matched
    |   |       `-- No eligible entities -> unmapped
    |   `-- partitionFromSourceJoins uses matched joins from the requested diagram revision
    |       |-- Retain overlapping memberships; lexicographic group ID selects primary membership
    |       `-- Uncovered entities retain no primary group
    |           `-- Join functions are available separately; the shown CLI supplies no diagram joins
    `-- CLI output depends on the completed artifact
        |-- Canonical serialization -> selected-scope.json.gz or whole-repository.json.gz
        |-- architectureReport -> Markdown report linked to the compressed artifact
        `-- Run manifest -> snapshot ID, byte hashes, sizes, coverage, counts and measurements
